motifs.name: king_pawn_shield_intact
motifs.description: The side to move has more pawns on the files adjacent to its own king than the opponent has near theirs.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'king_pawn_shield_intact'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has more pawns on the files adjacent to its own king than the opponent has near theirs.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm

    def shield_pawns(king_sq, color):
        king_file = chess.square_file(king_sq)
        king_rank = chess.square_rank(king_sq)
        count = 0
        for df in (-1, 0, 1):
            f = king_file + df
            if f < 0 or f > 7:
                continue
            # Look for friendly pawns on ranks that shield (in front of king)
            for r in range(king_rank + (1 if color == chess.WHITE else -1),
                           king_rank + (3 if color == chess.WHITE else -3),
                           1 if color == chess.WHITE else -1):
                if r < 0 or r > 7:
                    break
                sq = chess.square(f, r)
                piece = board.piece_at(sq)
                if piece and piece.piece_type == chess.PAWN and piece.color == color:
                    count += 1
                    break  # one pawn per file is enough for the shield
        return count

    stm_king = board.king(stm)
    opp_king = board.king(opp)
    if stm_king is None or opp_king is None:
        return False

    stm_shield = shield_pawns(stm_king, stm)
    opp_shield = shield_pawns(opp_king, opp)

    return stm_shield > opp_shield

motifs.name: king_attack_pressure
motifs.description: The side to move attacks more squares adjacent to the opponent king than the opponent attacks adjacent to the side-to-move king, with a margin of at least 2.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'king_attack_pressure'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move attacks more squares adjacent to the opponent king than the opponent attacks adjacent to the side-to-move king, with a margin of at least 2.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    # Find kings
    stm_king_sq = board.king(stm)
    opp_king_sq = board.king(opp)
    if stm_king_sq is None or opp_king_sq is None:
        return False
    
    # Get squares adjacent to each king
    stm_king_adj = set()
    opp_king_adj = set()
    for sq in chess.SQUARES:
        d = chess.square_distance(stm_king_sq, sq)
        if 1 <= d <= 2:  # include both adjacent and 2 squares away for king zone
            stm_king_adj.add(sq)
        d2 = chess.square_distance(opp_king_sq, sq)
        if 1 <= d2 <= 2:
            opp_king_adj.add(sq)
    
    # Count attacks by stm on opponent king zone
    stm_attacks_on_opp_zone = 0
    for sq in opp_king_adj:
        if board.attackers(stm, sq):
            stm_attacks_on_opp_zone += 1
    
    # Count attacks by opponent on stm king zone
    opp_attacks_on_stm_zone = 0
    for sq in stm_king_adj:
        if board.attackers(opp, sq):
            opp_attacks_on_stm_zone += 1
    
    return stm_attacks_on_opp_zone >= opp_attacks_on_stm_zone + 2

motifs.name: dominant_center_control
motifs.description: The side to move controls more central squares (d4, e4, d5, e5) than the opponent.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'dominant_center_control'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move controls more central squares (d4, e4, d5, e5) than the opponent.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    center = [chess.E4, chess.D4, chess.E5, chess.D5]
    stm_ctrl = 0
    opp_ctrl = 0
    for sq in center:
        if board.attackers(stm, sq):
            stm_ctrl += 1
        if board.attackers(opp, sq):
            opp_ctrl += 1
    return stm_ctrl > opp_ctrl

motifs.name: development_lead
motifs.description: The side to move has more pieces (knights and bishops) off their back rank than the opponent, indicating a development advantage.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'development_lead'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has more pieces (knights and bishops) off their back rank than the opponent, indicating a development advantage.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    # Define back rank squares for each color
    if stm == chess.WHITE:
        stm_back_rank = [chess.square(f, 0) for f in range(8)]
        opp_back_rank = [chess.square(f, 7) for f in range(8)]
    else:
        stm_back_rank = [chess.square(f, 7) for f in range(8)]
        opp_back_rank = [chess.square(f, 0) for f in range(8)]
    
    stm_developed = 0
    opp_developed = 0
    
    # Count developed minor pieces for stm
    stm_minors = list(board.pieces(chess.KNIGHT, stm)) + list(board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, stm))
    for sq in stm_minors:
        if sq not in stm_back_rank:
            stm_developed += 1
            
    # Count developed minor pieces for opponent
    opp_minors = list(board.pieces(chess.KNIGHT, opp)) + list(board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, opp))
    for sq in opp_minors:
        if sq not in opp_back_rank:
            opp_developed += 1
    
    # Only fire if stm has at least one developed piece
    if stm_developed == 0:
        return False
        
    # Require development lead of at least 1
    return stm_developed > opp_developed

motifs.name: fewer_pawn_islands
motifs.description: The side to move has fewer pawn islands than the opponent, indicating a healthier pawn structure.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'fewer_pawn_islands'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has fewer pawn islands than the opponent, indicating a healthier pawn structure.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    def count_islands(color):
        pawns = board.pieces(chess.PAWN, color)
        visited = set()
        islands = 0
        for sq in pawns:
            if sq in visited:
                continue
            islands += 1
            stack = [sq]
            visited.add(sq)
            while stack:
                csq = stack.pop()
                cf = chess.square_file(csq)
                cr = chess.square_rank(csq)
                for df in [-1, 0, 1]:
                    for dr in [-1, 0, 1]:
                        if df == 0 and dr == 0:
                            continue
                        nf = cf + df
                        nr = cr + dr
                        if 0 <= nf <= 7 and 0 <= nr <= 7:
                            nsq = chess.square(nf, nr)
                            if nsq in pawns and nsq not in visited:
                                visited.add(nsq)
                                stack.append(nsq)
            # Also check squares that are connected via same file adjacent ranks are part of same island
            # Actually, the above with all 8 directions already handles connectivity
        
        return islands
    
    stm_islands = count_islands(stm)
    opp_islands = count_islands(opp)
    
    return stm_islands < opp_islands

motifs.name: advanced_pawn_chain_advantage
motifs.description: The side to move has more pawns on the fifth rank or beyond than the opponent, indicating superior space and advanced structure.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'advanced_pawn_chain_advantage'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has more pawns on the fifth rank or beyond than the opponent, indicating superior space and advanced structure.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    # Count advanced pawns for each side (rank 5+ for White, rank 4- for Black)
    # For side to move: if White, advanced means rank >= 5 (index 4+); if Black, rank <= 4 (index 3-)
    stm_advanced = 0
    opp_advanced = 0
    
    for sq in chess.SQUARES:
        piece = board.piece_at(sq)
        if piece is None or piece.piece_type != chess.PAWN:
            continue
        rank = chess.square_rank(sq)
        if piece.color == chess.WHITE:
            if rank >= 4:  # rank 5 (index 4) or higher
                if piece.color == stm:
                    stm_advanced += 1
                else:
                    opp_advanced += 1
        else:  # BLACK
            if rank <= 3:  # rank 4 (index 3) or lower
                if piece.color == stm:
                    stm_advanced += 1
                else:
                    opp_advanced += 1
    
    return stm_advanced > opp_advanced

motifs.name: rook_on_open_file
motifs.description: The side to move has a rook on a file with no pawns of either color, while the opponent has no such rook.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'rook_on_open_file'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has a rook on a file with no pawns of either color, while the opponent has no such rook.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    def rook_on_open_file(color):
        for rook_sq in board.pieces(chess.ROOK, color):
            file_idx = chess.square_file(rook_sq)
            has_pawn = False
            for rank in range(8):
                sq = chess.square(file_idx, rank)
                p = board.piece_at(sq)
                if p and p.piece_type == chess.PAWN:
                    has_pawn = True
                    break
            if not has_pawn:
                return True
        return False
    
    stm_has = rook_on_open_file(stm)
    opp_has = rook_on_open_file(opp)
    
    return stm_has and not opp_has

motifs.name: bishop_blocked_by_own_pawns
motifs.description: The side to move has a bishop on the same color as its own pawns on that color's central squares, without the opponent having the same restriction.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'bishop_blocked_by_own_pawns'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has a bishop on the same color as its own pawns on that color\'s central squares, without the opponent having the same restriction.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm

    CENTER_SQUARES = [chess.E4, chess.D4, chess.E5, chess.D5]

    def count_blocked_bishop_squares(color):
        count = 0
        for sq in board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, color):
            sq_color = (chess.square_file(sq) + chess.square_rank(sq)) % 2
            for cs in CENTER_SQUARES:
                if (chess.square_file(cs) + chess.square_rank(cs)) % 2 == sq_color:
                    if board.piece_at(cs) and board.piece_at(cs).piece_type == chess.PAWN and board.piece_at(cs).color == color:
                        count += 1
                        break
        return count

    stm_blocked = count_blocked_bishop_squares(stm)
    opp_blocked = count_blocked_bishop_squares(opp)
    return stm_blocked > opp_blocked

motifs.name: connected_rooks
motifs.description: The side to move has two rooks connected (on same rank or file with no pieces between them) while the opponent does not.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'connected_rooks'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has two rooks connected (on same rank or file with no pieces between them) while the opponent does not.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm

    stm_rooks = board.pieces(chess.ROOK, stm)
    if len(stm_rooks) < 2:
        return False

    # Determine if stm has two connected rooks (same rank, clear path between them)
    stm_has_connected = False
    rook_list = list(stm_rooks)
    for i in range(len(rook_list)):
        r1 = rook_list[i]
        f1 = chess.square_file(r1)
        rk1 = chess.square_rank(r1)
        for j in range(i + 1, len(rook_list)):
            r2 = rook_list[j]
            f2 = chess.square_file(r2)
            rk2 = chess.square_rank(r2)
            if f1 == f2:
                # Same file: check if no pieces between them
                lo = min(rk1, rk2)
                hi = max(rk1, rk2)
                clear = True
                for rk in range(lo + 1, hi):
                    sq = chess.square(f1, rk)
                    if board.piece_at(sq) is not None:
                        clear = False
                        break
                if clear:
                    stm_has_connected = True
                    break
            elif rk1 == rk2:
                # Same rank: check if no pieces between them
                lo = min(f1, f2)
                hi = max(f1, f2)
                clear = True
                for f in range(lo + 1, hi):
                    sq = chess.square(f, rk1)
                    if board.piece_at(sq) is not None:
                        clear = False
                        break
                if clear:
                    stm_has_connected = True
                    break
        if stm_has_connected:
            break

    if not stm_has_connected:
        return False

    # Check opponent does not have connected rooks
    opp_rooks = board.pieces(chess.ROOK, opp)
    if len(opp_rooks) < 2:
        return True

    opp_rook_list = list(opp_rooks)
    for i in range(len(opp_rook_list)):
        r1 = opp_rook_list[i]
        f1 = chess.square_file(r1)
        rk1 = chess.square_rank(r1)
        for j in range(i + 1, len(opp_rook_list)):
            r2 = opp_rook_list[j]
            f2 = chess.square_file(r2)
            rk2 = chess.square_rank(r2)
            if f1 == f2:
                lo = min(rk1, rk2)
                hi = max(rk1, rk2)
                clear = True
                for rk in range(lo + 1, hi):
                    sq = chess.square(f1, rk)
                    if board.piece_at(sq) is not None:
                        clear = False
                        break
                if clear:
                    return False
            elif rk1 == rk2:
                lo = min(f1, f2)
                hi = max(f1, f2)
                clear = True
                for f in range(lo + 1, hi):
                    sq = chess.square(f, rk1)
                    if board.piece_at(sq) is not None:
                        clear = False
                        break
                if clear:
                    return False
    return True

motifs.name: bishop_on_weak_color_complex
motifs.description: The side to move has a bishop and the opponent has no bishop that can guard the squares on the bishop color, because all their pawns are on squares of that bishop color, while the opponent does not have such a bishop-versus-pawns color weakness to exploit.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'bishop_on_weak_color_complex'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has a bishop and the opponent has no bishop that can guard the squares on the bishop color, because all their pawns are on squares of that bishop color, while the opponent does not have such a bishop-versus-pawns color weakness to exploit.'
MOTIF_NAME = 'bishop_on_weak_color_complex'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has a bishop and the opponent has no bishop that can guard the squares on the bishop color, because all their pawns are on squares of that bishop color, while the opponent does not have such a bishop-versus-pawns color weakness to exploit.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm

    def has_bishop_color_weakness(color, other_color):
        bishops = board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, color)
        if not bishops:
            return False
        opp_bishops = board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, other_color)
        opp_pawns = board.pieces(chess.PAWN, other_color)
        if not opp_pawns:
            return False
        
        for b_sq in bishops:
            b_color = (chess.square_file(b_sq) + chess.square_rank(b_sq)) % 2
            opp_pawns_on_color = sum(1 for psq in opp_pawns 
                                     if (chess.square_file(psq) + chess.square_rank(psq)) % 2 == b_color)
            total_opp_pawns = len(opp_pawns)
            if total_opp_pawns == 0:
                continue
            pawn_ratio = opp_pawns_on_color / total_opp_pawns
            
            opp_bishops_guard = any(1 for ob_sq in opp_bishops 
                                    if (chess.square_file(ob_sq) + chess.square_rank(ob_sq)) % 2 != b_color)
            
            if pawn_ratio >= 0.6 and not opp_bishops_guard:
                return True
        return False

    stm_weak = has_bishop_color_weakness(stm, opp)
    opp_weak = has_bishop_color_weakness(opp, stm)
    return stm_weak and not opp_weak

motifs.name: knight_vs_bishop_control_imbalance

motifs.name: queenside_pawn_majority_advantage
motifs.description: The side to move has more pawns on the queenside (files a-d) than the opponent, with a margin of at least 2, indicating a favorable pawn majority for creating passed pawns.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'queenside_pawn_majority_advantage'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has more pawns on the queenside (files a-d) than the opponent, while the opponent king is not on the queenside, indicating a favorable pawn majority.'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has more pawns on the queenside (files a-d) than the opponent, with a margin of at least 2, indicating a favorable pawn majority for creating passed pawns.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    # Count pawns on queenside (files a-d) for both sides
    stm_queenside = 0
    opp_queenside = 0
    for sq in board.pieces(chess.PAWN, stm):
        if chess.square_file(sq) <= 3:
            stm_queenside += 1
    for sq in board.pieces(chess.PAWN, opp):
        if chess.square_file(sq) <= 3:
            opp_queenside += 1
    
    # Need a meaningful majority (at least 2 more pawns)
    if stm_queenside - opp_queenside < 2:
        return False
    
    # Check that opponent king is NOT on the queenside
    opp_king_sq = board.king(opp)
    if opp_king_sq is None:
        return False
    opp_king_file = chess.square_file(opp_king_sq)
    if opp_king_file <= 3:
        return False
    
    # Also check that side-to-move king is relatively safe (not on queenside under attack)
    stm_king_sq = board.king(stm)
    if stm_king_sq is None:
        return False
    stm_king_file = chess.square_file(stm_king_sq)
    stm_king_rank = chess.square_rank(stm_king_sq)
    
    # If stm king is on queenside, ensure it's not under immediate threat
    if stm_king_file <= 3:
        attackers = board.attackers(opp, stm_king_sq)
        if len(attackers) > 0:
            return False
    
    return True

motifs.name: passed_pawn_protected
motifs.description: The side to move has a passed pawn that is defended by a friendly pawn, while the opponent has no such supported passed pawn.

motifs.name: pawn_storm_against_kingside_castled_king
motifs.description: The side to move has at least two pawns on the files in front of the opponent castled king (f/g/h files for kingside castle), while the opponent has fewer such pawns against the side-to-move king.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'pawn_storm_against_kingside_castled_king'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has at least two pawns on the files in front of the opponent castled king (f/g/h files for kingside castle), while the opponent has fewer such pawns against the side-to-move king.'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has at least two pawns on the files in front of the opponent castled king (f/g/h files for kingside castle), while the opponent has fewer such pawns against the side-to-move king.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm

    # Determine castling side for each king based on rook/king position
    # Kingside castle: king on g-file and rook on f-file or h-file, or just king on g/h files near corner
    # Simpler: if king is on g-file or h-file (files 6,7) and hasn't moved far from back rank, call it kingside
    # Or: king is on files 6-7 and rank is 0 (stm) or 7 (opp) with rook nearby? 
    # Better: detect if king is on its back rank and on files e,f,g,h. If king on e-file with rook on h-file -> kingside potential.
    # Actually, let's just check if opponent king is on kingside (files 6-7) and near back rank.
    
    opp_king_sq = board.king(opp)
    if opp_king_sq is None:
        return False
    stm_king_sq = board.king(stm)
    if stm_king_sq is None:
        return False
        
    opp_king_file = chess.square_file(opp_king_sq)
    opp_king_rank = chess.square_rank(opp_king_sq)
    
    # Check if opponent king is castled kingside: on files f,g,h and on ranks 0-1 or 6-7 (back two ranks)
    # For Opp: if white, back rank is 0; if black, back rank is 7
    if opp == chess.WHITE:
        opp_back_rank = 0
    else:
        opp_back_rank = 7
        
    # Kingside castle: king on g-file (6) or h-file (7), or king on f-file (5) with rook on h-file
    # Simplify: king on files >= 5 (e,f,g,h) and rank within 1 of back rank
    if opp_king_file < 5:  # e-file or less -> not kingside
        return False
    if abs(opp_king_rank - opp_back_rank) > 1:
        return False
        
    # Kingside files in front of opponent king: f, g, h (files 5,6,7) for the opponent's side
    # Pawns on those files for STM, advanced (rank >= 4 for white STM, rank <= 3 for black STM? Actually just count STM pawns on those files)
    # The pawn storm: STM has pawns on the files in front of opponent castled king
    
    # Define the kingside files relative to opponent
    # f,g,h are files 5,6,7 regardless of color
    ks_files = {5, 6, 7}
    
    stm_pawns_on_ks = 0
    for sq in board.pieces(chess.PAWN, stm):
        if chess.square_file(sq) in ks_files:
            stm_pawns_on_ks += 1
            
    if stm_pawns_on_ks < 2:
        return False
        
    # Now check STM king side; is STM castled kingside? If yes, opp should have fewer pawns on those files
    stm_king_file = chess.square_file(stm_king_sq)
    stm_king_rank = chess.square_rank(stm_king_sq)
    if stm == chess.WHITE:
        stm_back_rank = 0
    else:
        stm_back_rank = 7
        
    # If STM is also castled kingside, compare
    stm_ks_castled = (stm_king_file >= 5 and abs(stm_king_rank - stm_back_rank) <= 1)
    
    if stm_ks_castled:
        opp_pawns_on_ks = 0
        for sq in board.pieces(chess.PAWN, opp):
            if chess.square_file(sq) in ks_files:
                opp_pawns_on_ks += 1
        # STM must have more pawns on kingside files than opponent
        if stm_pawns_on_ks <= opp_pawns_on_ks:
            return False
            
    return True

motifs.name: bishop_pair_advantage
motifs.description: The side to move has both bishops while the opponent has at most one bishop.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'bishop_pair_advantage'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has both bishops while the opponent has at most one bishop.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    stm_bishops = len(board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, stm))
    opp_bishops = len(board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, opp))
    return stm_bishops >= 2 and opp_bishops <= 1

motifs.name: queen_attacking_king_zone_without_opponent
motifs.description: The side to move has a queen attacking squares adjacent to the opponent king while the opponent has no queen attack on the side-to-move king zone.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'queen_attacking_king_zone_without_opponent'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has a queen attacking squares adjacent to the opponent king while the opponent has no queen attack on the side-to-move king zone.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm

    stm_king = board.king(stm)
    opp_king = board.king(opp)
    if stm_king is None or opp_king is None:
        return False

    def king_zone_squares(king_sq):
        zone = set()
        kf = chess.square_file(king_sq)
        kr = chess.square_rank(king_sq)
        for df in (-1, 0, 1):
            for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
                f = kf + df
                r = kr + dr
                if 0 <= f <= 7 and 0 <= r <= 7:
                    zone.add(chess.square(f, r))
        zone.discard(king_sq)
        return zone

    opp_zone = king_zone_squares(opp_king)
    stm_zone = king_zone_squares(stm_king)

    stm_queens = board.pieces(chess.QUEEN, stm)
    opp_queens = board.pieces(chess.QUEEN, opp)

    stm_attacks = False
    for qsq in stm_queens:
        attacked = board.attacks(qsq)
        if attacked & opp_zone:
            stm_attacks = True
            break

    opp_attacks = False
    for qsq in opp_queens:
        attacked = board.attacks(qsq)
        if attacked & stm_zone:
            opp_attacks = True
            break

    return stm_attacks and not opp_attacks

motifs.name: rook_invading_opponent_territory
motifs.description: The side to move has a rook on the opponent side of the board while the opponent has no rook on the side-to-move side.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'rook_invading_opponent_territory'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has a rook on the opponent side of the board while the opponent has no rook on the side-to-move side.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    stm_rooks = board.pieces(chess.ROOK, stm)
    opp_rooks = board.pieces(chess.ROOK, opp)
    
    def on_opponent_half(sq, color):
        rank = chess.square_rank(sq)
        return (color == chess.WHITE and rank >= 4) or (color == chess.BLACK and rank <= 3)
    
    stm_has = any(on_opponent_half(sq, stm) for sq in stm_rooks)
    opp_has = any(on_opponent_half(sq, opp) for sq in opp_rooks)
    
    return stm_has and not opp_has
